rationale: The stock gapped down and bled all day to within 0.5% of its low on heavy relative volume, but the current tape is mechanically dead — five consecutive flat 5-minute candles with volume evaporating (10K down to 567) and 1-cent ATR — indicating intraday selling momentum has exhausted rather than continuing.
